DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。忘れ物について、何をご相談されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about a lost item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手袋を落としました。片方はまだ持っているので、なくしたのは右だけです。届いていないか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手袋の右側だけをなくし左は手元にあると伝え、届いているか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I dropped a glove. I still have one, so only the right one is missing. I'd like to ask whether it's been handed in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you lost only the right glove and still have the left, and ask whether it has been handed in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 残っている手袋と、最後に両方あった場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show the glove you still have and tell me where you last had both.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これが左で、灰色に赤い線があります。休憩した時には両方外し、その後右だけ見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残った左手袋の色と線を示し、休憩時に両方外してから右が見つからないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the left one. It's gray with a red stripe. I took both off during a break, and haven't found the right one since.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the remaining left glove's color and stripe, and explain the right has been missing since removing both during a break. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 移動した経路と、その間に手袋を使った場面も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's also check your route and any times you used gloves along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 休憩所から広場を通りました。途中で友人の手袋を借りたので、写真に写る黒いものは私のではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩所から広場への経路を伝え、途中の写真の黒い手袋は友人から借りたもので自分のではないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I went from the rest area through the open space. I borrowed my friend's gloves along the way, so the black ones in the photo aren't mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the route from the rest area through the open space and say the black gloves in the photo were borrowed from a friend, not yours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真の手袋と探している手袋を区別します。ご自身の手袋を見分ける印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll distinguish the photographed gloves from the one you're seeking. Does your own glove have an identifying mark?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 内側に名前があります。左にも同じ名前があるので、残っているものを担当へ見せて照合したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内側の氏名で見分けられると伝え、残った左手袋を担当に見せて照合したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: My name is inside. The left has the same name, so I'd like to show the remaining glove to staff for comparison.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the inside name can identify it and ask to show the remaining left glove to staff for comparison. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保管品に、灰色に赤い線の右手袋が一枚あります。こちらが内側の名前です。お持ちの左手袋と、線の模様、サイズ、名前を照らし合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: There's one gray right glove with a red stripe among the stored items. Here's the name inside. Please compare the stripe pattern, size, and name with your left glove.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左と同じ模様とサイズで、内側の名前も私のものです。写真の黒い借り物ではなく、探していた右手袋だと確認できました。こちらを受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保管された右手袋の模様、サイズ、内側の名前が手元の左手袋と一致し、借りた黒い手袋ではなく自分の右だと確認して受け取ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: The pattern and size match the left, and the inside name is mine. I've confirmed this is the right glove I was seeking, not the borrowed black one in the photo. I'll collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the stored right glove's pattern, size, and inside name match the left in hand, it is your right glove rather than the borrowed black one, and say you will collect it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認できた右手袋をお渡しします。左右がそろいましたね。お忘れ物に気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01219-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll hand you the verified right glove. You have both now. Please take care not to leave anything behind on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。運行の案内で、何をご確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about service information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯で運休という表示を見ました。士別から乗る私の列車も来ないのか、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯で運休表示を見たので、自分が士別から乗る列車も来ないのか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw a canceled-service notice on my phone. I'd like to check whether my train from Shibetsu won't arrive either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you saw a cancellation notice on your phone and want to check whether your own train from Shibetsu is also not coming. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対象の路線と列車、情報の更新日時を見ましょう。お持ちの切符も確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's look at the relevant line, train, and information update time. May I also check your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この切符です。画面は別の路線の情報でした。自分の便が運休と決まったわけではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切符を示し、画面は別路線の情報だったので自分の便が運休と決まったわけではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the ticket. The screen was showing information for another line. So it doesn't establish that my service is canceled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your ticket and confirm the screen concerned another line, so your service is not established as canceled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご利用の便について最新案内を確認します。運休と遅延では、次に確認する内容も違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the latest information for your service. Cancellation and delay require different follow-up checks too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 遅れている場合でも、予定の時刻のまま迎えを待ってもらわないよう連絡します。到着の見込みが未定なら、それも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 列車が遅れていれば迎えの相手に連絡し、到着の見込みが未定ならそのことも伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even if it's delayed, I'll contact the person meeting me so they won't wait based on the scheduled time. If expected arrival is undecided, I'll tell them that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will contact the person meeting you if the train is delayed and also tell them if expected arrival is undetermined. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。変更する場合は、切符の購入元と取扱いも確認しましょう。どちらで買いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. If making a change, let's also check where you bought the ticket and the handling rules. Where did you buy it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ネットで購入しました。駅で全部変えてもらえると思わず、購入元の変更案内を先に見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 切符はネットで購入したと答え、駅ですべて変更できるとは考えず購入元の案内を先に見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Online. I won't assume the station can change everything; I'll first look at the seller's change instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the ticket was bought online and you will look at the seller's instructions first rather than assume all changes can be made at the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 駅で確認できる運行情報と、購入元での変更手続きを分けてください。別の便を重ねて買う前にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Distinguish service information the station can check from change procedures with the seller. Please check before buying another overlapping service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の便の運行を確認し、迎えの相手へ更新を伝えます。変更が必要なら購入元の条件を見てから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の便の最新運行情報を確かめて迎えの相手に伝え、変更が必要なら購入元の条件を確認してから決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check my own service and update the person meeting me. If a change is needed, I'll decide after reading the seller's conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will verify your service's latest information and tell the person meeting you, then decide any necessary change after checking the seller's conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。対象の便を取り違えないよう、最新案内をご確認ください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the latest information without confusing which service it applies to. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。相談窓口をお探しですか。どのような用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you looking for an advice counter? What is it about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事を失った後の生活について相談したいです。書類の期限も近いので、先に話せる窓口を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 失業後の生活について相談したく、書類の期限も近いので先に話せる窓口を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like advice about living after losing my job. A document deadline is close too, so I'd like to first find a counter I can speak to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want advice about life after unemployment and a document deadline is near, so you want to first check where you can speak. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書類の内容と、今困っていることを分けて伺います。今日相談したいのは、ご本人のことですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask about the documents separately from what is troubling you now. Is today's consultation about yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私のことです。友人に予約を手伝ってもらったので、予約者の欄が友人の名前になっているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談は自分のことだが友人に予約を手伝ってもらったため、予約者欄が友人の名前かもしれないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. A friend helped me book, so the booking-person field may contain my friend's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the consultation is for yourself but a friend helped book, so the booking person's field may have their name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 控えを見ると、「申込者」はご友人の名前ですが、「相談する本人」はあなたの名前になっています。名前が違うだけで別人の相談とは限りません。期限が書かれた書類も見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The confirmation shows your friend as the applicant, but your name as the person receiving advice. Different names alone don't necessarily mean advice is for someone else. Please also show the document with the deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この控えと書類です。申請そのものと生活の相談を一つと思っていたので、期限の手続きは別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約の控えと期限の書類を示し、申請手続きと生活相談を一つと考えていたので期限の手続きは別に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here are the booking record and document. I thought the application itself and living advice were one thing, so I'll check the deadline procedure separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the booking record and deadline document and say you thought application procedures and living advice were one, so you will check deadline procedures separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が異なる場合もあります。書類の期限と相談の希望をどちらも担当へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Different staff may handle them. Please tell the staff both the document deadline and your wish for advice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 期限までに何を出すかを先に聞き、その後、収入が減った生活の相談を予約したいです。友人は付き添いとして来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限までに提出するものを先に聞き、その後で収入が減った生活の相談を予約したいと伝え、友人は付き添いだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll first ask what to submit by the deadline, then book advice about managing with reduced income. My friend will accompany me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you first want to ask what must be submitted by the deadline, then book advice about reduced-income living, and explain your friend is accompanying you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談する本人の欄はあなたで、友人は申込みを手伝った方ですね。予約名を変える必要があるかは担当に確認します。付き添いの希望と、書類の期限を先に確認したいことも分けてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You're the person receiving advice, and your friend helped make the application, correct? We'll check with staff whether the booking name needs changing. We'll separately pass on your wish for accompaniment and to check the document deadline first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相談者は私、友人は付き添いと説明します。期限付き申請と生活相談を分け、予約の氏名と担当を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談者は自分で友人は付き添いだと説明し、期限付き申請と生活相談を分けて予約氏名と担当を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain I'm the person seeking advice and my friend is accompanying me. I'll separate the deadline application from living advice and check the booking name and responsible staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you are the advice recipient and your friend the companion, and will distinguish the deadline application from living advice and check the booking name and staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。控えと書類を持って担当へご相談ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring the booking record and documents to the staff. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受診の準備で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with preparing for your medical visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 睡眠の記録を持ってくるよう言われました。夜勤の日もあるので、実際の時刻をどう書くか担当に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜勤があるので、睡眠記録に実際の時刻をどう書くか担当者に確認したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told to bring a sleep record. I work night shifts some days, so I'd like to ask staff how to enter the actual times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you work night shifts and want staff to check how to enter actual times in your sleep record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 用紙と、ご自身で書いた記録を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the form and the records you wrote yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。昼に寝た日を、夜の睡眠と同じ時刻へ書き換えず、起きた時刻もそのまま記しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昼間に寝た場合も、実際に寝た時刻と起きた時刻を変更せず書くと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. For days I slept during the day, I didn't change the times to match nighttime sleep; I also wrote the actual waking times unchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you record actual sleep and wake times unchanged even when sleeping in the daytime. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ記入の確認を依頼します。職場での休憩は記録していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask staff to check your entries. Have you recorded breaks at work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 休憩の時刻はあります。でも寝ていたとは限らないので、休憩全部を睡眠時間に数えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務中の休憩は睡眠とは限らないので、区別して記録したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have break times. But I wasn't necessarily asleep, so I won't count the whole break as sleep.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say work breaks are not necessarily sleep and you want to record them separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 実際にわかる状態を分けて伝えてください。覚えていない時刻はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please distinguish the states you actually know about. Are there any times you don't remember?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二日前に目が覚めた時刻は覚えていません。仕事の開始から逆算して、正確な時刻として書くのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二日前に起きた時刻は不明なので、逆算した時刻を正確な記録として書かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't remember when I woke two days ago. I won't work backward from the work start time and write it as an exact time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the waking time two days ago is unknown, so you will not enter a backward-calculated time as an exact record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 昼に眠った実時刻は睡眠欄、勤務の休憩は休憩欄、二日前の起床時刻は「不明」と別にしました。休憩を眠った時間へ足してはいません。記録と一致していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've separated the actual daytime sleep times into the sleep field, work breaks into the break field, and waking two days ago as unknown. I haven't added breaks to sleeping time. Does this match your record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、昼の睡眠時刻はそのままで、休憩も睡眠へ足されていません。二日前の起床は不明になっています。この分けた用紙で担当に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 睡眠と休憩が別欄で昼の実時刻が保たれ、二日前の起床は不明と記録されたと確認し、その用紙で医療担当へ説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Daytime sleep times are unchanged, and breaks haven't been added to sleep. Waking two days ago is unknown. I'll explain to the staff using this separated form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm sleep and breaks occupy separate fields with actual daytime times preserved and waking two days ago unknown, and say you will explain to medical staff using that form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 欄の分け方を確認できました。覚えていない起床を逆算で埋めずに残しています。用紙を医療担当へお見せください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've checked the field separation. The unknown waking time remains unfilled rather than estimated backward. Please show the form to medical staff. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。なくした物について、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about a missing item?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の鍵束をなくしました。タグに住所を書いていたので、紛失の届け出と、今することを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所を書いたタグ付きの家の鍵束をなくしたので、紛失の届け出と今必要な対応を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost my house keys. The tag had my address on it, so I'd like to report the loss and ask what I should do now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you lost house keys with an address tag and want to discuss a lost-property report and necessary actions now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に鍵を見た場所と時刻を教えてください。ご自宅には今、安全に入れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where and when you last saw them. Are you able to enter your home safely now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日、仕事先で見ました。家族の鍵で家には入れます。でも、なくした鍵に住所があるので不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後に鍵を見たのは昨日の仕事先で、家族の鍵で自宅には入れるが、紛失した鍵に住所があるため不安だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I saw them at work yesterday. I can get in with my family's key. But I'm worried because my address is on the missing keys.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you last saw the keys at work yesterday and can enter with a family key, but are worried because the lost keys show your address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紛失の状況を記録します。住居の保護については、管理者などへ状況を伝えて相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll record the circumstances of the loss. For protecting your home, explain the situation to management or another appropriate party and ask for advice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大家さんへ連絡します。勝手に鍵を交換せず、必要な対応と手順を確認したいです。タグの形も説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大家に連絡して鍵を勝手に交換せず必要な対応と手順を確認し、タグの形も説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll contact my landlord. I won't replace the lock without permission; I'd like to check necessary measures and steps. I'll describe the tag's shape too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will contact the landlord, check necessary measures and steps rather than replace the lock yourself, and describe the tag's shape. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 鍵束の本数と特徴を教えてください。拾得物の確認も、特徴を照らし合わせて行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell me the number of keys and their features. Found property is also checked by matching features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三本で、丸い緑のタグです。似た鍵が届いていても、私が家の鍵穴で試して確認する方法は取りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵は三本で丸い緑のタグが付いており、似た拾得物があっても自宅の鍵穴で試す方法は取らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Three keys, with a round green tag. Even if similar keys are handed in, I won't test them in my home's lock to verify them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say there are three keys with a round green tag and you will not test similar found keys in your home's lock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。担当が情報を照合します。連絡先と、最後に見てからの移動経路もお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Staff will compare the information. Please also give your contact details and route since you last saw them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三本、緑の丸タグ、住所記載と伝えます。仕事先からの経路を整理し、大家さんへ住居の対応を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鍵三本、緑の丸いタグ、住所の記載という特徴を知らせ、仕事先からの経路を整理して大家に住居の対応を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll say three keys, a round green tag, and my address on it. I'll organize my route from work and ask my landlord about measures for the home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe three keys, a round green tag, and address marking, organize your route from work, and say you will discuss home measures with the landlord. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記録と相談先をご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll explain the report and where to ask for advice. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。配達について、何をご相談されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about delivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 追跡では配達済みですが、荷物が見つかりません。もう一度届けてもらう前に、どこへ届いたか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 追跡では配達済みなのに荷物が見つからないので、再配達を頼む前に届け先を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tracking says delivered, but I can't find the parcel. Before asking for it to be delivered again, I'd like to check where it went.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say tracking shows delivered but the parcel is missing, so you want to check the delivery location before requesting redelivery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配達完了の表示と、実際の受け取りを分けて確認しましょう。ご家族や指定した置き場所は確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the delivered display separately from actual receipt. Have you checked with family and any designated drop-off location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族には聞きましたが、受け取っていません。注文時に置き場所を指定したかは覚えていないので、まず注文の案内を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族は受け取っておらず注文時に置き場所を指定したか覚えていないので、注文の案内を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I asked my family, but they haven't received it. I don't remember whether I specified a place when ordering, so I'll first look at the order information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say family did not receive it and you do not remember specifying a drop-off place, so you will check the order instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 指定の有無と配達の案内を確認してください。確認した結果をもとに、担当へ照会します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check whether a place was specified and the delivery guidance. We'll inquire with staff based on what you confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内には玄関横の箱とあります。玄関だけ見て、箱の中はまだ確認していません。誤配と決める前に見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定場所が玄関横の箱とわかったがまだ中を見ていないので、誤配と決める前に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The instructions say the box beside the entrance. I only looked at the entrance and haven't checked inside that box yet. I'll look before deciding it was misdelivered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the designated spot is a box beside the entrance that you have not checked inside yet, and will check before concluding misdelivery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 安全に確認できる場所をご確認ください。見つからなければ、追跡番号と確認済みの内容をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check only places you can access safely. If it's still missing, give us the tracking number and what you've already checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 箱にもありませんでした。家族と玄関横の箱は確認済みです。この番号で配達記録を調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱にも荷物がなく家族と指定場所は確認済みだと報告し、追跡番号を示して配達記録を調べてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It wasn't in the box either. I've checked my family and the box beside the entrance. Could you look up the delivery record with this number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the parcel was not in the box and family and the designated place have been checked, and show the tracking number to request a delivery-record inquiry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ照会します。まだ原因はわからないので、再配達の可否も確認結果に沿ってご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask the staff. The cause is still unknown, so whether redelivery is possible will also be explained according to the check results.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 配達済み表示でも手元にはないと伝えます。指定場所と家族を確認した結果と番号を示し、担当の返答を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 配達済み表示でも手元にないことと、家族や指定場所の確認結果、追跡番号を伝えて担当者の返答を待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll say I don't have it despite the delivered display. I'll give the number and results of checking family and the designated place, and wait for the staff's reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the delivered status does not mean you have it, give family and designated-place check results and the tracking number, and wait for staff's reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。配達状況を確認する担当へつなぎます。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll connect you with the staff who check delivery status. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。カードの保護で、何を確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about protecting your card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カードが見当たらず、アプリで停止のボタンを押しました。これで紛失の連絡まで済んだか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カードが見つからずアプリで停止ボタンを押したので、それで紛失の連絡も済んだか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I couldn't find my card and pressed the suspension button in the app. I'd like to know whether that also completed reporting it lost.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your card is missing and you pressed the app suspension button, and ask whether that completed the lost-card report too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 操作した機能の名前と、完了画面を確認しましょう。銀行への紛失の相談は、別にされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the function's name and completion screen. Have you also separately consulted the bank about the loss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話はしていません。画面は一時的な利用制限とあります。紛失の届け出と同じと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話はしておらず画面には一時的な利用制限と表示されているので、紛失の届け出と同じだと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't called. The screen says temporary usage restriction. I thought that was the same as reporting the loss.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you have not called and the screen says temporary usage restriction, which you thought was the same as reporting loss. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この完了画面には「対象はATMでのカード利用」とあり、紛失受付の完了や口座全体の停止とは書かれていません。画面の内容とカードがないことを担当へ伝え、必要な連絡を別に確認しましょう。 銀行への電話は未実施とも記録し、紛失の連絡まで完了したとは扱いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This completion screen says it covers card use at ATMs, not completion of a lost-card report or stopping the entire account. Let's tell staff what the screen says and that the card is missing, and separately check the necessary contact. We'll also record that you haven't called the bank and won't treat loss reporting as completed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 画面に出ている制限だけで、全部の取引が止まるとは考えません。何が制限され、ほかに必要な対応があるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 画面の制限だけですべての取引が止まるとは考えず、制限の範囲と追加で必要な対応を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume the restriction shown stops every transaction. I'd like to ask what's restricted and what further action is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume the screen restriction stops all transactions and want to ask its scope and additional required actions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が確認してご案内します。カードを最後に使った日と、確認できる明細はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff will check and explain. Do you have the date you last used the card and a transaction record you can check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日使った明細があります。覚えのない取引があるかも確認しますが、今この場で全て正常と断定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昨日使った明細があるので身に覚えのない取引も確認するが、今すべて正常とは断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have yesterday's transaction slip. I'll also check for unfamiliar transactions, but won't declare everything normal here now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have yesterday's use record and will check for unknown transactions, without declaring everything normal now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 画面で確認できたのはATMでのカード利用の制限だけです。ほかの機能と紛失受付は未確認として担当へ伝えます。昨日の明細と、気になる取引の日付・金額を分けてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The screen has confirmed only a restriction on card use at ATMs. We'll tell staff other functions and the lost-card report are unconfirmed. Please bring yesterday's slip separately from the dates and amounts of any concerning transactions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一時制限の画面、カード不在、最後の利用を示します。紛失の連絡と保護の範囲を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一時制限の画面とカードが見つからない状況、最後の利用を示し、紛失の連絡と保護される範囲を担当者に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the temporary-restriction screen, the missing card situation, and the last use. I'll check loss reporting and the protection scope with staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the temporary-restriction screen, missing-card situation, and last use, and say you will check loss reporting and the scope protected with staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へおつなぎします。画面の案内もご確認ください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll connect you with the staff. Please check the screen instructions too. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。商品の状態で、何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Has something happened with a product's condition?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った卵に割れがありました。二個ですが、気づいた時が違うので、分けて説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日買った卵のうち二個が割れているが気づいた時が違うので、分けて説明したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two eggs I bought yesterday were cracked. I noticed them at different times, so I'd like to explain separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say two of yesterday's eggs are cracked but you noticed them at different times, so you want to explain separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品とレシートを確認します。二個の状況を、それぞれ教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the product and receipt. Please tell me the circumstances for each of the two eggs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一個は会計の後で割れているのに気づきました。もう一個は家で落として割ったので、その分を交換してほしいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一個は会計後に割れに気づき、もう一個は家で自分が落としたためその分の交換は求めないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I noticed one was cracked after checkout. The other broke when I dropped it at home, so I'm not asking for that one to be exchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you noticed one cracked after checkout, but dropped and broke the other at home and are not requesting exchange for that one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入時の状態と、ご自身で落とした物を分けて確認しましょう。写真や包装は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the condition at purchase separately from the one you dropped yourself. Do you still have photos or the packaging?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会計後に撮った写真と包装があります。昨日は急いでいたので戻れませんでした。未使用の物だけ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会計後に撮った写真と包装があり、昨日は急いで戻れなかったので未使用の商品だけ持ってきたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the photo taken after checkout and the packaging. I was in a hurry yesterday and couldn't come back. I've brought only the unused items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have a post-checkout photo and packaging, could not return in yesterday's hurry, and brought only unused products. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品の状態と対応条件を確認します。交換や返金は、確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the product's condition and response conditions. We'll explain exchange or refund options after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 購入時の一個の対応を相談します。自分で割った分を含めて、二個とも元から割れていたとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会計後に割れを見つけた一個の対応を相談し、自分で割った分まで購入時から割れていたとは言わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to discuss what can be done about the one from purchase. I won't claim both were cracked from the start, including the one I broke myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are asking about the one found cracked after checkout, without claiming the one you broke was also cracked at purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。確認した内容と対応の選択肢をご説明します。職員へ商品をお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We'll explain the confirmed details and available responses. Please hand the product to staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 発見した時刻の違いを伝え、写真とレシートを示します。家で落とした分は別として、購入時の状態を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見時点の違いを説明して写真とレシートを示し、家で落とした分とは分けて購入時の状態を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain the different discovery times and show the photo and receipt. Please check the condition at purchase separately from the one I dropped at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the discovery-time difference, show the photo and receipt, and ask for the purchase condition to be checked separately from the one dropped at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。状況を分けてご説明いただき、ありがとうございました。確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for explaining the circumstances separately. We'll check and advise you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。散歩の経路で、何をご相談されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about your walking route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 表示の距離を一周の長さと思って歩きました。疲れてきたので、今いる所から短く戻る方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 表示距離を一周の長さだと思って歩いたが疲れたので、現在地から短く戻る方法を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I walked thinking the distance on the sign was for a full circuit. I'm getting tired and would like a short way back from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought the displayed distance was a whole circuit and walked, but are tired and want a short way back from your current location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その表示は「入口から見晴台まで二キロ、片道」です。一周の距離ではありません。戻りたいのは、出発した同じ入口でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: That sign says 'Two kilometers from the entrance to the viewpoint, one way.' It isn't the circuit distance. Do you want to return to the same entrance you started from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初の入口です。来た道を同じだけ戻ることを考えていませんでした。家族も疲れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最初の入口へ戻りたいが来た道を同じだけ戻ることを考えておらず、家族も疲れていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The original entrance. I hadn't considered going back the same distance along the route. My family is tired too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want the original entrance but had not considered returning the same distance, and family are tired too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 家族と一緒に休憩して、利用できる帰路を確認しましょう。通路の外を近道にする必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's rest together with your family and check usable return routes. There's no need to take a shortcut off the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: バスで戻れたらと思いますが、地図に乗場の印があるだけで、今日使えるとは決められませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰りにバスを使いたいが地図の乗場の印だけでは今日利用できると判断できないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was hoping to return by bus, but a stop symbol on the map alone doesn't establish that it's available today, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want a bus for the return but confirm a boarding symbol on the map alone doesn't mean it is usable today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日の案内のバスは別の入口行きで、出発した入口には戻りません。その便に乗れば同じ入口へ着く、という案内ではないのでご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The bus in today's information goes to another entrance, not the one you started from. Please note this does not mean it will take you back to the same entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別の入口では困るので、そのバスには乗りません。まず家族とここで休み、出発した入口までの帰り道と途中で休める所を地図で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内のバスは別の入口行きなので利用せず、家族と現在地で休み、出発した入口への帰路と途中の休憩所を地図で確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Another entrance won't work, so I won't take that bus. First, I'd like to rest here with my family, then check the route to our original entrance and places to rest along it on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not take the bus to another entrance, will rest here with family, and want to check the return route to your starting entrance and rest stops on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 帰りはこの舗装通路で出発した入口へ戻れます。途中の休憩所はこちらの印です。今いる場所で休んでから、ご家族と一緒に休憩を挟んでお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: This paved path returns to the entrance you started from. This symbol marks a rest area along the way. Rest here first, then return together with your family, taking breaks en route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 片道二キロで、バスは違う入口へ行くと確認できました。今休んでから、家族と離れず、案内された帰路で途中も休憩しながら戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示は片道二キロでバスは別入口行きだと確認し、現在地で休んでから家族と離れず案内の帰路で休憩を挟み戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed it's two kilometers one way and the bus goes to a different entrance. After resting now, we'll stay together and return along the route you described, resting along the way too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the display is two kilometers one way and the bus serves another entrance, and say you will rest now then return together with family along the indicated route, taking breaks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。十分休み、無理に先へ進まないでください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01220-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Rest well and don't force yourselves farther onward. Have a safe return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。切符について、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about tickets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通勤の定期券がありますが、今日は普段より先の駅へ行きます。別の切符を最初から買う必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 定期券の区間より先へ行くと伝え、最初から別の切符を買う必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a commuter pass, but today I'm going beyond my usual station. Do I need to buy a separate ticket from the beginning?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are traveling beyond your pass section and ask whether you need a separate ticket from the start. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの定期券の区間と、今日の目的地を確認しましょう。券を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the section covered by your pass and today's destination. May I see the pass?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 定期の区間はこちらで、目的地はその先です。全部を買い直すと決めず、必要な追加分を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 定期区間とその先の目的地を示し、全部を買い直さず必要な追加区間を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the pass section, and my destination is beyond it. Rather than decide to repurchase the whole journey, I'd like to check the extra part needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the pass section and destination beyond it, and say you want to check the necessary extra section without buying the whole trip again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用する経路によって取扱いを確認します。定期の区間と同じ道を通る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the handling according to your route. Do you plan to travel the same way as your pass section?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 行きは同じですが、帰りは友人と別の経路になるかもしれません。行きの追加と帰りの券を別に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 行きは定期と同じ道だが帰りは未定だと説明し、行きの追加分と帰りの券を分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: On the way there, yes, but I may return by another route with a friend. I'd like to ask separately about the outward supplement and the return ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the outward route matches your pass but the return is undecided, and ask about the outward extra and return ticket separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 行きと帰りを分けて確認しましょう。帰りの経路が未定なら、決まってから購入の方法を調べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check outward and return separately. If the return route is undecided, you can look up how to buy once it's settled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 往復の券をすぐ買わず、今日は行きに必要な分だけ確認します。定期券も一緒に持って乗ればよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 往復券をすぐ買わず行きの必要分だけ確認すると伝え、定期券も持って乗るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't buy a return ticket immediately; today I'll check only what's needed outward. Please tell me whether to carry my commuter pass too when riding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not immediately buy a return ticket but check only the outward requirement, and ask whether you should carry the pass too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な券の組み合わせと利用方法を確認してご案内します。定期券の区間を自己判断で書き換えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the necessary ticket combination and how to use it. Don't alter the pass's section yourself based on your own judgment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 定期の区間、目的地、行きの経路を示します。追加の購入と持参する券を確かめ、帰りは経路が決まってから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 区間、目的地、行きの経路を示して追加の購入と必要な券を確認し、帰りは経路が決まってから選ぶと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the pass section, destination, and outward route. I'll check the extra purchase and tickets to bring, and choose the return once its route is decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the section, destination, and outward route, confirm extra purchases and needed tickets, and say you will choose the return after its route is decided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。券の内容を照らし合わせてから購入に進みましょう。お気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01221-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let's compare the ticket details before proceeding to purchase. Have a safe journey.
